answer: 问题: Sybil farms mint disposable keys. 机制: Each sponsor opens one rate-capped inlet admitting ≤4 new keys/epoch; admitted keys join a nebula of 12 peer-scored clusters and climb a trellis of 6 lock tiers (80→480 POA, +80 each). 成本: N fakes cost N×tier-lock plus spent inlet slots. 验证: Peers recompute inlet tickets and trellis depth hashes every epoch. 失败处理: Ticket reuse or depth forgery burns the lock and prunes that nebula branch within 2 epochs.
